page0.text:
...I'll protect Saber.
Even though she might not be able to defeat him, she should have an advantage if she focuses on retreat.
There's about five meters between us.
If Kuzuki takes another step, Tohsaka should be able to react and dodge any strike.

page1.text:
But Saber is different.
Her neck is half cut off like Rider and she's been thrown into a wall.
Saber's situation is far more dire.
Even if she's invincible against mages, she'll be easily defeated by Caster in that state...!

page2.text:
"I'm counting on you, Tohsaka...!"
I grip my sword and charge towards Kuzuki in front of me.

page3.text:
My true objective is to reach Saber before she is attacked by Caster.
I'll take a swing as I pass.
I'm sure he'll dodge it, but Tohsaka should be able to take advantage of the opening...!

page4.text: I swing the sword as I pass by Kuzuki's side.

page5.text:
"G-guh...!?"
It doesn't even do anything.
The wooden sword crumbles to pieces, and the blow from his fist makes me lose my footing.
He rushes in at Tohsaka in an instant.

page6.text:
Time stops.
Tohsaka is astonished, but she immediately points her hand at Kuzuki.

page7.text:
And the right hand of the enemy...
The hand that wrecked Saber's neck strikes her in the chest.

page8.text:
"Agh... Guh...!"
All of the air in Tohsaka's lungs goes out.
Then...
A hammering blow, like a battering ram against a castle, strikes her face mercilessly.

page9.text:
"Toh...saka..."
...I witness my own fate as I see her miserable state.
...Tohsaka's face isn't there.
There's nothing left where Kuzuki's blow struck.

page10.text:
"You made the wrong decision, Emiya, just like Caster."
"..."
I can't raise my head.
...Just like a student that doesn't know the answer and can't bear to face the teacher, I can't look at Kuzuki.
I stand there, unable to walk.
